title: Update report form title text to single-spaced exact wording

requirements.summary: Change the existing report form title string to the exact provided English text with single spaces only, without altering any other UI/layout/styling.
acceptanceCriteria: On the report form, the title text is exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
There is only a single space between all words, including between "GPS" and "leader".
No other visual/UI/layout/styling changes occur on the report form page (only the title string changes).

file_operations.description: Locate the existing report form title field (the same title previously defined in this UI) and update only its displayed string to exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice" using normal single spaces; do not change any other logic, layout, styling, or surrounding copy.
